title: LIVE Ranking Every NEW YouTube Niche We Found
one_sentence_summary: The creator demonstrates an AI-powered system utilizing custom mega-prompts and MCP tools to rapidly scan, evaluate, and tier-rank emerging faceless YouTube niches.
key_takeaways: To find successful and uncrowded faceless YouTube niches quickly, leverage AI-driven research prompts rather than manual searches.
Evaluate potential niches based on three core criteria: channel age under 2 months, fewer than 3 close competitors, and easy replication for under $600 a month.
Start your channel research by choosing topics aligned with your personal interests to maintain motivation and passion for the content.
Rank niches on a tier list based on their production complexity and replication difficulty, prioritizing barriers to entry that protect against market saturation.
Consistently track competitor entry rates weekly to assess market viability and avoid over-saturated categories.

actionable_frameworks.name: Faceless YouTube Niche Evaluation Framework
actionable_frameworks.description: A three-part metric used to vet new YouTube niches: ensuring the channel is not older than 2 months, has fewer than 3 close competitors, and is easy to replicate for under $600 a month.

memorable_quotes: In my opinion, if you build a channel around your interests, you'll have more passion about it, you will be more motivated to put in the work required.
The moment you develop the skill of recognizing patterns, that's going to become way easier for you to then create your own niche using niche bending.
